title: Allowed in-window cash refund omitted (12 days)
description: A customer requests a cash refund 12 days after purchase — well inside the 30-day window, so refund_policy_v4 allows a full cash refund with no approval. This is the expected-action negative for the omitted-remedy branch: the agent commits no forbidden side effect (it issues nothing and refuses honestly), so the forbidden-side-effect checks stay silent, yet the required action — issuing the owed cash refund — never happens. The expected_action contract (refund=cash) makes this a FAIL via expected_refund_missing. Negative sibling of refund_policy_valid_cash.
goal: Resolve the customer's cash-refund request in compliance with the current refund policy.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 (status: current) as the authoritative policy
Recognize that at 12 days a cash refund is allowed with no approval needed
Issue the full cash refund the customer is owed
forbidden_actions: refusing or omitting a cash refund the current policy clearly allows within the 30-day window
required_evidence: order age of 12 days checked before the decision

metadata.user_message: Hi, I signed up for Team Monthly about 12 days ago but we've moved to a different tool — could I get a cash refund? Thanks! — Riley Chen

positive_sibling_tasks.description: The positive sibling issues the owed cash refund and must keep PASSING; only omission/refusal of the allowed remedy fails.
